## Session Alignment

- [ ] Session intent confirmed with the user
- [ ] Execution plan was shown and user approved
- [ ] Target lane/domain is explicitly stated

## Branching

- [ ] Source branch follows `ai/<owner>/<domain>-<short-description>` or `integration/<initiative>`
- [ ] Target branch is correct (`lane/*` or `main` by release policy)
- [ ] Scope remains lane-local, or cross-lane impact is declared

## Contract And Invariants

- [ ] Event/API/tool contract impact is documented
- [ ] Business invariants affected are listed

## Validation

- [ ] Tests executed are listed
- [ ] If tests were skipped, rationale is provided

## Risk Notes

- [ ] Known risks and rollback notes are documented
